sampling_method: Deterministic stable sort by file_id ascending, LIMIT 1014
provenance_explanation: In Phase 4.3, 1,014 was an intermediate snapshot cut-off taken while the full-corpus baseline was actively executing. This script reproduces the deterministic extraction from the completed 7,300 configuration full-corpus progress log.

summary.conclusion: The erroneous criterion of 'no rendering' has been eliminated. The general compatibility and playability of these games is not yet proven.
